_doc: Intentional exceptions of the c334-GUARD-* suites, rebuilt from IDevelop's own schema. Every entry needs a `reason` of at least 8 characters; keys other than reason/id must equal the probe's (an entry without `table` matches the column in every table). Sections: enumLiterals (file, col, literal), staticLocaleKeys (key), legacySpellings (table, col, value), hyphenValues (table, col, value), localeStates (table, col, prefix, value), dateIso (file, col), unconstrainedColumns (table?, col), routes (method, url), ticks (name or file).
